description: Starter manifest for apps that capture spoken conversations (meetings, calls, interviews) and want CQ's LLM extraction to turn transcripts into typed memory. Send interaction_type=meeting_transcript with the transcript as content; prefix speaker labels per line and mark the app user's label with '(you)'.
design_principles: Domain-agnostic: works for any meeting type without vertical-specific branching.
Every CQ facet is represented so recall has all six cognitive roles to draw from.
Adapt by renaming domain types and tightening descriptions — not by adding code.

patch_types.description: A stable behavioral pattern the app user self-discloses. Only ever about the (you) speaker.
Something the app user prefers or avoids, stated in their own words.
A concrete action someone agreed to take. Carry the owner and any spoken deadline.
patch_types.cue_guidance: Name the deliverable or workstream the commitment advances, not the meeting it was made in.

patch_types.description: Something preventing progress. Resolves when the obstruction clears.
Something the group agreed or ruled out. Capture what was decided, not the debate.
A noteworthy fact or insight from the conversation that fits no stronger type.
A named participant or mentioned individual. value.text is the NAME ONLY.
A named unit of ongoing work that meetings and commitments attach to.

connection_labels.label: belongs_to
connection_labels.description: Scopes an episode-type patch to the project it belongs to.

connection_labels.label: owns
connection_labels.description: The named person is responsible for the action item.

connection_labels.label: blocked_by
connection_labels.description: The commitment cannot proceed until the blocker resolves.

entity_types.description: Named individuals, indexed for recall matching.

extraction_rules.guidance: Only specifically named individuals. Unnamed speakers (Speaker 4) must NOT become entities.

entity_types.description: Named workstreams, indexed for recall matching.

extraction_prompt_guidance.role_context: You are a structured data extraction engine turning meeting transcripts into typed memory patches. Extract only what was actually said; never infer facts the transcript does not support.
